Keys: WASD or arrows walk · drag to look · Shift run · E use · G talk · B Motor Pool · M map · P maps · L ledger · T time · F weather · Esc menu. Gamepad: A use · Start menu · LB/RB switch tabs. Touch: the stick walks; Use, Map, Maps and Menu buttons.

Real places are named only as places — a parish, a neighbourhood, a bridge, a park, a canal, a port. Every building is generic character by district, the map is stylised and approximate, not a survey, and limits are always "per the plan, permit or label". Satellite ground appears only when you have supplied a Mapbox token (docs/mapbox.md). Progress is kept in this browser under your profile.
